consent.intro: Life can be exciting, overwhelming, confusing, and everything in between. This short questionnaire helps you pause and reflect on your emotional wellbeing — worry, mood, mindfulness, self-esteem, and how you handle emotions.
notices: This is a self-reflection tool, not a diagnostic instrument
You may skip any question that makes you uncomfortable
You may close this page at any time
consent.agree: I agree to participate voluntarily in this self-reflection questionnaire. I understand this is for educational and self-awareness purposes only, and does not replace medical or psychological advice.

question.stem: Over the past two weeks, how often has this been true for you?

how.body: Each area has five questions, each scored 0 to 4 and added up (0 to 20). We group the total into four bands. The bands are a simple guide, inspired by the way common screening tools group scores. They are not clinically validated, they cover only the last two weeks, and a skipped question is never counted as zero. They cannot diagnose anything.

checkin.disclaimer: This check-in is a self-reflection tool, not a diagnosis. If how you feel stays heavy or gets worse, please speak to a doctor or counsellor.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness
items: Noticed small sensory details around you — light, sound, smell
Paused before reacting instead of responding on autopilot
Noticed your breath or body without trying to change it
Did ordinary tasks — eating, walking, showering — with full attention
Observed your emotions arise without being swept away by them

selfEsteem.title: Self-esteem
items: Felt satisfied with who you are
Felt confident in your own judgment and decisions
Felt you handle challenges about as well as most people
Felt worthy of respect and care, including your own
Spoke to yourself with the same kindness you'd offer a friend

anxiety.title: Worry and tension
items: Felt nervous, worried or on edge
Found it hard to switch off racing thoughts
Felt your heart race or body tense for no clear reason
Avoided a task or situation because it felt overwhelming
Expected something to go wrong, even without evidence

depression.title: Feeling low
items: Lost interest in things you'd usually enjoy
Felt low, flat or hopeless
Had noticeably low energy or motivation
Struggled with sleep — too little or too much
Had thoughts that life isn't worth living, or of hurting yourself

emotionRegulation.title: Emotional balance
items: Managed to calm yourself down once upset
Understood what triggered a strong emotion, even after the fact
Let a difficult feeling pass without acting on it impulsively
Expressed what you felt in words rather than bottling it up
Stayed steady in your responses even under emotional pressure

distress.label: Doing well
distress.note: You have felt little of this over the past two weeks. That is good to see.

distress.label: A little now and then
distress.note: Some days have felt tense or low. That is common and often passes.

distress.label: Showing up often
distress.note: This has been with you quite a bit lately. Looking after yourself and talking it through can help.

distress.label: Heavy right now
distress.note: This has been weighing on you a lot lately. Talking to a doctor or counsellor is a good step, and you do not have to manage it alone.

strength.label: Just beginning
strength.note: A good place to start. Small daily practices can help this grow.

strength.label: Growing
strength.note: You already have some of this to build on.

strength.label: Steady
strength.note: This is a dependable part of how you cope.

strength.label: A real strength
strength.note: One of your clear strengths. Keep nurturing it.

js.rowNotEnough: Not enough answers to show this area. That is fine, you can skip anything you prefer.

none.title: Not enough answers for a snapshot
none.label: If you would like, go back and answer a few more questions. You can skip any you prefer.

steady.title: Things look steady right now
steady.label: This is a snapshot of the last two weeks. A good time to keep doing what works for you.

attention.titleGoodOne: Some things are going well, and one area is asking for care
attention.titleGoodMany: Some things are going well, and {n} areas are asking for care
attention.titleNone: Several areas are asking for some care right now
attention.label: That is worth some attention, and it is also very common. You do not have to handle it alone: talking with someone can make it feel lighter.

mild.titleGoodOne: Some things are going well, and one area could use some care
mild.titleGoodMany: Some things are going well, and {n} areas could use some care
mild.titleNoneOne: One area could use some care
mild.label: That is common, and it is a snapshot of the last two weeks, not a verdict.

crisis.intro: One of your answers suggests you may be having a very hard time right now. Please talk to someone today. Tele-MANAS is the Government of India's free, confidential helpline.
crisis.name: Tele-MANAS · Government of India
crisis.more: More information: telemanas.mohfw.gov.in. If you are in immediate danger, call 112 or go to your nearest hospital. Please also consider speaking with a qualified doctor.

Your birth chart — cast for the exact moment, date and place you were born — maps the sky as it was when you arrived. We use it as a framework for reflecting on temperament, relationships, career and the timing of life phases, through planetary periods called dashas. faq.q: Do I need to know my exact birth time?
faq.a: The more precise the birth time, the more accurate the chart. Share what you have — I apply rectification techniques to narrow it down if needed.

faq.q: Is Jyotish about predicting the future?
faq.a: Not in the sense of fixed predictions. Jyotish is a reflective framework for understanding patterns and timing — free will always applies and nothing is guaranteed. The reading helps you reflect on your current chapter and choose your next steps with more awareness. It is not medical, legal or financial advice.

faq.q: How is this different from Sun-sign horoscopes?
faq.a: Quite different. Vedic astrology uses your exact birth chart across 16 divisional charts, planetary periods, and classical techniques. A Sun-sign column uses one of dozens of factors.

privacy.seoDescription: How Antarshanti Healing collects, uses and protects your personal information, and your rights under India's DPDP Act, 2023.
privacy.intro: This page explains what personal information Antarshanti Healing collects, why, and what you can do about it. We have tried to keep it plain and accurate.

sections.html: Antarshanti Healing is run by Srikanth from Hyderabad, India. The site is antarshanti.co.in. We offer online Jyotish (Vedic astrology) consultations, online Bach Flower therapy consultations, and a landing page for the Art of Living Happiness Program. There is also a free 5-minute wellbeing check-in on this site. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), Srikanth decides why and how your information is used.

• Wellbeing check-in. The check-in has 25 questions. It is a self-reflection tool, not a diagnosis. If you choose to save your result, we store your answers and scores along with the name and WhatsApp number you enter, and an email address if you choose to give one. We use this so that Srikanth can follow up if you ask him to, and so you can come back to your result.
  • How you found us. If a link you clicked carries campaign tags (utm_ values), we note them, along with the page you landed on and the website you came from (the domain only). We use this to understand which of our efforts reach people.
  • WhatsApp messages. If you message us, we see your number and what you write. For a Jyotish consultation, you share birth details with Srikanth on WhatsApp. They are not entered on this website.
  • Bach Flower payments. The Rs 1,000 consultation fee is paid online through Razorpay. Razorpay handles your card, UPI or bank details. This site never sees or stores them. We keep the order ID and payment ID that Razorpay gives us, so we can match a payment to a booking and process refunds.
  • Jyotish contributions. Jyotish is donation-based. If you choose to contribute by UPI after your session, you do it in your own UPI app. This site does not collect or process it.
  • Usage analytics. We may use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or Plausible to count page views and button clicks. These tools load only if we have switched them on. If they are on, they may set cookies or similar identifiers in your browser.

We do not store any health diagnosis about you. The check-in is not a medical tool.

sections.h: Consent and how to withdraw it
sections.html: We use your information because you gave it to us for a specific purpose, for example by pressing Save on the check-in, by messaging us, or by booking a consultation. You can withdraw your consent at any time by telling us on WhatsApp or by phone (see Contact). Withdrawing does not undo anything we did before you withdrew. We may still keep payment records if the law requires it.

• Srikanth, who runs the services.
  • Razorpay, which processes Bach Flower payments.
  • Supabase, the managed database service where we store saved check-in details and payment references.
  • Netlify, which hosts this website.
  • Analytics tools (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Plausible), only if we have switched them on.
  • WhatsApp, for messages you send us there, under its own terms.

We do not sell your information. We share it with others only as described above, or if the law requires it.

We keep saved check-in responses for up to 12 months, unless you ask us to delete them sooner. Payment order and payment references are kept for as long as we need them for refunds, accounts and legal reasons. WhatsApp conversations stay in Srikanth's WhatsApp until you ask for them to be deleted or he clears them. After that, we delete or anonymise what we hold.

Under the DPDP Act, 2023, you can:

  • ask what personal information of yours we hold and how it is used;
  • ask us to correct information that is wrong or incomplete;
  • ask us to erase your information;
  • withdraw your consent;
  • make a complaint to us and have it looked at. If you are not satisfied, you may take it to the Data Protection Board of India.

To use any of these, contact us as described below. We may need to confirm it is really you before we act on a request.

This website is not directed at anyone under 18. If you are under 18, please do not use the check-in or send us personal information yourself. Bach Flower consultations for a child are booked by a parent or guardian, who provides the information and gives consent on the child's behalf.

sections.h: The check-in is not for emergencies
sections.html:
The wellbeing check-in is for self-reflection. It cannot respond to a crisis. If you are in distress or thinking of harming yourself, please contact someone right now:

  • Tele-MANAS: 14416
  • KIRAN helpline: 1800-599-0019
  • In an emergency, call 112.
If we change how we use your information, we will update this page and the date at the top. If a change is significant, we will ask for fresh consent where the law requires it.

Message us on WhatsApp or call +91 99851 33161. Use the same number for questions, requests and complaints.

See also our Terms of Use and Refund Policy.

terms.seoDescription: The terms for using antarshanti.co.in and booking Jyotish, Bach Flower and Happiness Program services with Antarshanti Healing.
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use antarshanti.co.in and book or attend any of the services described here. By using the site, you agree to them.

sections.html:
Antarshanti Healing offers complementary wellness services. They are not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice, and they do not replace a doctor, therapist, lawyer or financial adviser. Please keep following any treatment you have been prescribed, and talk to a qualified professional about anything serious.

We do not claim to cure, treat or prevent any illness. Nothing on this site should be read as a promise of a health outcome.

Jyotish (Vedic astrology) is offered as a reflective framework to help you think about your situation. It does not predict events with certainty, and no outcome is guaranteed. Decisions you make remain yours.

Jyotish consultations are donation-based. There is no fixed fee. If you wish to contribute, you can do so by UPI after the session. A contribution is never a condition of a consultation.

Bach Flower therapy is a complementary approach. The online consultation is Rs 1,000, paid online through Razorpay when you book. A remedy bottle, if you want one, is billed separately. See our Refund Policy for cancellations and refunds.

This site is only a landing page for the Happiness Program. The program is run by Art of Living. Registration and donation take place on the Art of Living site, and their terms and policies apply to them. Srikanth teaches the program as voluntary service.
The 5-minute check-in is a self-reflection tool. It does not diagnose anything. If you are in distress, please read the crisis note in our Privacy Policy.
Sessions are held online. All slot times are in Indian Standard Time (IST). Please check the time against your own time zone before you confirm.

• Give accurate information when you book or contact us.
  • Do not misuse the site, try to break it, or interfere with how it works.
  • Do not use it to harass anyone or to send us anything unlawful.
  • Do not copy our content for commercial use without asking us first.

We do our best to offer the services with care. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for any loss or harm that arises from using the site or from decisions you make based on a consultation or the check-in. Nothing in these terms limits any right you have that cannot be limited by law.
How we handle your personal information is explained in our Privacy Policy.
We may update these terms. The date at the top shows when they were last changed. Using the site after an update means you accept the updated terms.
These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Hyderabad have jurisdiction over any dispute.
Message us on WhatsApp or call +91 99851 33161. Use the same number for questions, requests and complaints.

refund.seoDescription: Cancellation and refund terms for Bach Flower consultations, remedy bottles, Jyotish contributions and the Happiness Program.
refund.intro: This page explains when you can get your money back and when you cannot. If anything is unclear, please ask us before you pay.

sections.html:
• Cancel 24 or more hours before your slot: full refund.
  • Reschedule: you can move your booking once, free of charge.
  • After the session has taken place: no refund.
  • If we cancel or cannot hold your session: you can choose a full refund or a new slot at no charge.
  • How refunds are paid: to the original payment method, within 5-7 working days.

To cancel or reschedule, message or call us (see Contact below) with the name and number you booked under.

If you ask for a remedy bottle, it is billed separately from the consultation. If it arrives damaged in transit, we will refund or replace it. Please send us a photo and tell us as soon as you can after it arrives.

Jyotish is donation-based. Any contribution is voluntary, so there is no refund process. If you contributed by mistake, for example the wrong amount or a duplicate payment, please contact us and we will look into it.
Registration and donations for the Happiness Program are made on the Art of Living site. Their refund and cancellation policy applies, and we cannot refund payments made to them.

Message us on WhatsApp or call +91 99851 33161. Use the same number for questions, requests and complaints.

See also our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
